missing_evidence: Order service logs and dependency operation metrics to identify why order returns 502
Payment service logs/metrics explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
candidates.statement: Order service returns 502 to gateway checkout; traces show POST order failing with 502 Bad Gateway while inventory reservation succeeds (200) and payment authorization returns 503, so order's upstream failure propagates as gateway 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Order's own logs and dependency metrics are excluded; the internal cause of order's 502 (payment 503 vs postgres) is not isolated.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout shows repeated 502s with low latency (~47-94ms), and traces consistently show order returning 502 while inventory reservation succeeds and payment returns 503. The failure originates downstream of gateway at order. Logs were excluded and no order/payment-side telemetry is admitted, so the precise internal fault is not established; bounded candidate is order-side 5xx propagation.
